name: Expectations
overview: Scripture reveals that godly expectations are firmly rooted in trusting God's sovereign plans and promises. Believers are called to wait patiently on the Lord, recognizing that their hope and expectation come from Him alone, as seen in Psalms 62:5. The righteous can anticipate gladness and reward, assured that their expectations will not be cut off (Proverbs 10:28; 23:18; 24:14). Furthermore, God declares His intentions to give His people an expected end filled with peace rather than harm, emphasizing His faithful guidance and establishment of their paths (Jeremiah 29:11; Job 22:28).
